_why: The shape container's source of truth. Each entry names ONE LinkML schema and the reified artifacts generated from it. Shapes are morphed by dev and only read by prod: generate_shapes.py writes these artifacts, check_shape_artifacts.py proves they still trace to their source, and nothing in runtimes/ generates anything.
_gaps: What the generators do and do not carry, and the traps, are measured once in docs/architecture/LinkMlGaps.md. Read that before converting a hand-written shape. Restating it here would give the same fact two homes, and two homes is how a fact drifts.
_not_yet_in_the_shape_gems: Artifacts land here, NOT under gems/shapes-*/. Every NodeShape inside the governed TTL trees must be registered in six places, and dropping a generated shape into contracts/mind-pod/ failed all six at once. Promotion means re-freezing the baseline across all 174 shapes -- a governance act, not a pipeline step. See ADR 0069's consequences.

sources.why: The pod's Note, asserted once. Ruby projects it through vv-graph Storable, Python reads it at the MIND seam, and the browser surface reads it as JSON -- three hand-written assertions of one shape before this.
Profile 11 record types, derived from the Ruby vocabulary's TYPE_KEYS and DIMENSIONS. First cut: keys and enumerations asserted, cardinality not.
